name: Morino Shigezou
source:
[url=/c6711]Izumi[/url] and [url=/c6710]Kurumi[/url]'s father, the world-famous authority on genetic engineering. A man who participated in the Human Genome Project, a project with the goal to clarify the whole particulars of humans by analyzing the genomes they possessed. He made striking results on said project.

(Never7)
[spoiler]He used cloning techniques at a time where cloning was still illegal to create Kurumi's clone ― [url=/c6708]Haruka[/url].[/spoiler]

(Ever17)
[spoiler]He met [url=/c28]Yubiseiharukana[/url] by chance when she was suffering from a severe heart disease and was on the verge of despair, and perhaps because he has two daughters close to her age, they eventually developed a father-daughter relationship. He convinced You, who had only a short time left to live, to give birth to [url=/c29]a clone[/url], and he offered to fully support her.[/spoiler]

[spoiler]He has a deep knowledge of both Curé Syndrome and the Curé Virus.[/spoiler]

(From the Never7/Ever17 PSP-exclusive TIPS)
